Implemented the Python migration under `latency_utils/`, with Java-style compatibility imports under `org.LatencyUtils` and top-level class modules.

Includes interval estimators, pause detectors/listeners, time services, histograms, and `LatencyStats` with pause correction and builder APIs.

Core API checks pass. The supplied public suite has two failures caused by inconsistent assertions in test-local implementations, unrelated to repository code.
